function.name: KB_search
function.description: Search the knowledge base for relevant documents.

query.description: The search query to find relevant documents
query.title: Query

function.name: grep
function.description:
Search for a regex pattern in all knowledge base documents.

Returns documents ranked by number of matches, with full content.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for (e.g., 'credit.*card', 'fee|charge')
pattern.title: Pattern

function.name: transfer_to_human_agents
function.description:
Transfer the user to a human agent.

The proper transfer reason enum can be found in the knowledge base: search it before calling this tool to select the proper applicable reason.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue and what was attempted before transfer.
summary.title: Summary

reason.description: The specific reason code for the transfer.
reason.title: Reason

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.

function.name: get_user_information_by_id
function.description: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their user id.

function.name: get_user_information_by_name
function.description: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their name. Case Sensitive.

function.name: get_user_information_by_email
function.description: Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their email.

function.name: change_user_email
function.description: Change the email address for a user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose email should be changed
user_id.title: User Id

new_email.description: The new email address to set for the user
new_email.title: New Email

function.name: get_referrals_by_user
function.description: Get all referrals made by a user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user (referrer) to look up referrals for
user_id.title: User Id

function.name: get_credit_card_transactions_by_user
function.description: Get all credit card transactions for a user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to look up transactions for
user_id.title: User Id

function.name: get_credit_card_accounts_by_user
function.description:
Get all credit card accounts for a user.

Returns information about each credit card account including card type,
date opened, current balance, and reward points.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to look up credit card accounts for
user_id.title: User Id

function.name: log_verification
function.description:
Log a verification record after successfully verifying a user's identity.

Call this tool after you have verified a user by confirming 2 out of 4 identity fields
(date of birth, email, phone number, address). This creates an audit record of the verification.

date_of_birth.description: The verified user's date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY format)
date_of_birth.title: Date Of Birth

time_verified.description: The timestamp of the verification (e.g., "2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST")
time_verified.title: Time Verified

function.name: give_discoverable_user_tool
function.description:
Pass a tool to the user so they can execute it themselves.

Use this when the knowledge base indicates that the user should perform
an action themselves (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)").

The user will then be able to call `call_discoverable_tool` with the same
tool name and arguments to simulate executing the action.

discoverable_tool_name.description: The name of the discoverable tool (e.g., "open_webpage", "navigate_to_section")
discoverable_tool_name.title: Discoverable Tool Name

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"url": "https://example.com"}')
arguments.title: Arguments

function.name: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool
function.description:
Unlock an agent discoverable tool that was found in the knowledge base.

Use this when the knowledge base indicates that you have access to a specialized
internal tool. The knowledge base will tell you the tool name to unlock.

After unlocking, you can use the tool by calling `call_discoverable_agent_tool` with
the tool name and required arguments.

agent_tool_name.description:
The name of the agent discoverable tool to unlock
(e.g., "calculate_apr_adjustment_7842")
agent_tool_name.title: Agent Tool Name

function.name: call_discoverable_agent_tool
function.description:
Call an agent discoverable tool that you have previously unlocked.

Use this after unlocking a tool with `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool`. The knowledge base
will tell you which tool to use and what arguments to provide.

agent_tool_name.description: The name of the agent discoverable tool to call
agent_tool_name.title: Agent Tool Name

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"user_id": "abc123"}')
arguments.title: Arguments

function.name: list_discoverable_agent_tools
function.description:
List all agent discoverable tools that you have called.

Use this to see what specialized tools you have used.
